programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: A mysterious well filled with bones reveals a strange practice in ancient Persia; archaeologists digging in Mongolia uncover a 2000-year-old textile that holds the key to the mystery of an elixir; in Sichuan, China, hanging coffins are discovered.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: The journey begins and the truth they seek may reside in author Farley Mowat's journals and Joe's meeting with a modern-day artist. So begins the quest for the lost Vikings.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Manasseh and his mother, Nelly, return to Zambia to reconnect with family and tackle the unanswered questions in their own relationship; Manasseh gains a deeper appreciation of his Zambian heritage and makes peace with his own past.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Aleksander returns to Serbia for the first time in almost 30 years, traveling with his son, Sebastian, to discover the places and people left behind during the Kosovo War; Sebastian searches for a better understanding of his heritage and his father.

programs.title: A Cold War of Spies
programs.desc: In the 1960s, both countries have a grip on nuclear weapons, but the imbalance between U.S. and Soviet missiles is staggering; a fledgling communist government in Cuba provides the perfect opportunity for Nikita Khrushchev to position missiles.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: Gold and silver mining in the Kootenay Mountains created overnight cities and a legion of millionaires; Justin and Mike visit Sandon, British Columbia, to learn the history of the boom and bust cycles and experience some luck of their own.
